Class GitHubStatusNotifier

java.lang.Object
ci.notify.GitHubStatusNotifier
All Implemented Interfaces:
notify
public final class GitHubStatusNotifier extends Object implements notify
notify implementation that reports CI results to GitHub using commit statuses (REST API).

This notifier posts a status to the commit SHA received in the webhook payload, so the result appears on the commit and on pull requests. The status is posted using GitHubStatusClient.

Configuration

The notifier can be created from environment variables via fromEnv():

  • GITHUB_TOKEN (required) - token used to authenticate to GitHub
  • GITHUB_API_BASE (optional) - defaults to https://api.github.com
  • CI_STATUS_CONTEXT (optional) - status label shown on GitHub; defaults to kth-ci/build
  • CI_PUBLIC_BUILD_URL (optional) - link shown as "Details" on GitHub (e.g. ngrok URL)

Error handling

Failures to notify GitHub (network errors or non-2xx responses) are logged to System.err and are intentionally not thrown further, so notification problems do not fail the CI pipeline.

      public void notify(CiTrigger trigger, BuildResult result)
      Posts a commit status to GitHub for the commit referenced by the given trigger.

      This method extracts a WebhookPayload from CiTrigger and delegates to notifyFromPayload(WebhookPayload, BuildResult).

      Specified by:
      notify in interface notify
      Parameters:
      trigger - CI trigger containing webhook information
      result - CI build result to report
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if trigger or result is null
      IllegalStateException - if the trigger does not expose a WebhookPayload

    • notifyFromPayload

      public void notifyFromPayload(WebhookPayload payload, BuildResult result)
      Posts a commit status to GitHub using data directly from the webhook payload.

      This method exists primarily to simplify unit testing, by avoiding any dependence on the concrete CiTrigger implementation.

      Parameters:
      payload - parsed webhook payload containing repository and commit SHA
      result - CI build result to report
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if payload or result is null
